name: Verrière
summary: A perfume house's still life. One bottle, large, in a warm light studio on travertine: the visitor turns it by dragging (the house's turntable frames). The notes are one sentence set across the bottle, top at the neck, heart at the shoulder, base at the foot, each with a fine rule to the glass; the name large at the top left; sizes and Buy in one row under the plinth. Warm stone ground, ink, pale champagne gold from the perfume itself. Hina Mincho for the name, the notes and every line the house writes; SUSE in sentence case for the menu, sizes and buttons. Then the engraving desk, half picture, half form. For perfume houses and new brands launching.
